observations: ProcessStartInfo.ArgumentList avoids shell quoting; UTF-8 without BOM is configured for stdin/stdout/stderr, both output pipes drain asynchronously, stdin closes before waiting and non-success Git statuses fail closed.

Path serialization uses NUL-separated check-ignore input and C-quoted UTF-8 bytes for hash-object --stdin-paths, with spaces preserved, quote/backslash/control escapes and three-digit octal bytes for non-ASCII. Normalized candidate paths already pass retained workspace, leaf-file and reparse-point checks.

Default check-ignore tracked-file behavior matches r2; candidates are deduplicated with ordinal comparisons only after every accepted pin remains independently checked. Mandatory QA summary and release body are always added even if ignore rules would classify them.

Tagged ls-tree records require valid 40-digit blob identities and exact path lookup; ignored inventory validates status, terminal NUL, membership and uniqueness. Current hash output requires exact count, hash format and per-path equality. Repository-relative paths are hashed from the repository working directory, retaining the prior clean-filter context.

Direct source diff retains all original size/SHA/type/workspace/reparse, target tag, native payload, manifest and frozen ZIP gates. Only Git classification/tree/hash subprocesses and returned batching metadata change. Publish, Verify and Finalize wrappers were independently compared and differ only in the imported Assert basename.

Existing immutable actual preflight reports 405 input and 2093 bound identities, 49 payload files and 850 exact tagged/current blob comparisons; eight direct r2 CLI examples, all six ignored classifications and six C-quote vectors passed. These are inspected prior execution results, not executions by this reviewer.
limitations: This is an observational source review. No new Git hash/filter fixture, full preflight, remote-tag check or game regression was run. Existing actual r3 preflight evidence is pinned separately.
